svg.aria-label: switchback — a pi extension that routes requests through a fallback list and classifies provider failures with a SystemOne classifier
svg.title: switchback — quota-aware model fallback for pi
svg.desc: A terminal window showing the switchback flow: a request to zai/glm-5.3 returns a 429 quota error, the classifier returns class=quota with a reset time, and the router switches to ollama-cloud/glm-5.3-flash.
